sn43.15:1.1: Nibbāna is the truth since delusion has ceased ([mn140:26.2]()).
sn43.16:1.1: This is a common metaphor, eg. [snp5.18:1.3]().
sn43.17:1.1: For this term and the next, see [dhp36:1](), [thag2.46:2.3]()
sn43.19:1.1: This word (_ajajjara_) doesn’t appear elsewhere in Pali. _Jarjara_ (Sanskrit “decrepit”) sometimes appears in the sense “old age” (Vimalakīrtiniddesasūtra 2.8, Arthaviniścayasūtra 314, Pratītyasamutpādādivibhaṅganirdeśasūtra 118)
